items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024

ctx.x: Yes. Joel Dorn produced most of those things from Atlantic. And yeah, we would do the recordings and I would go to Joel Dorn and he would ask me how much I want you know, for the arranging, for the writing. And I would give him a little small amount you know. I didn’t know. I said, “Oh give me $75 or whatever.” And then the next time I’d say maybe, “Give me $100” something like that. And I kept doing that. And one time I went to the union and I asked the union what’s the union rate? And they told me okay well…

have a look at that. And then we had this little inside thing. He had a way of rocking. And I said, “Rahsaan, don’t go to that poor blind man move on me.” And he would just laugh and say, “No, man, you pay me this amount of money” and everything. But he would say, “Dick, you know man, if I could see” and he started groaning. I said, “Uh uh, don’t go there, poor blind man, don’t pull that one on me, it ain’t going to work with me today you know. And we would just have so much fun you know and laughing. He loved —…
This morning I watched the now-classic or well known video of Rahsaan and the group on Ed Sullivan.
